admission.rationale: Exact listed documents admitted only for selected historical claims after independent source/identity/semantic/correction review. No source-wide, latest/current or production collector admission.

automated_collection.rationale: Satisfied only for already completed bounded official-page research and paced official metadata verification recorded in admission-ledger.json; no future or general collector permission.

raw_retention.rationale: Outside reviewed subset: no raw publisher text, artwork, raw filing copies or proprietary identifier values.

internal_extraction.rationale: Selected public factual fields from exact SEC-hosted filings; reuse policy independently checked.

identifier_database_use.rationale: Only official CIK/accession and independently reviewed issuer/class labels. No proprietary security identifier values or third-party mapping database.

derived_publication.rationale: SEC policy supports this minimized factual historical subset with source links and qualifications. Source rights clearance is separate from exact-bundle maintainer publication authorization.

raw_redistribution.rationale: Outside reviewed subset: no raw publisher text, artwork, raw filing copies or proprietary identifier values.

attribution.rationale: Exact SEC URL, accession, locator, source claimant and report/filing dates retained. No SEC verification or endorsement implied.

commercial_use.rationale: Broader commercial product use not reviewed; this release is noncommercial research.

sources.cadence: Source-specific historical filing observations; no refresh job or universal latest-data claim.
limitations: Exact admitted documents and four historical claims only.
No current holdings, complete portfolio/AUM, ownership/control strengthening or duplicate exposure.
No raw files, proprietary instrument identifiers, artwork or private contact details.
SEC hosts filer statements and has not necessarily reviewed them for accuracy.
Metadata inventory proof and source-specific cutoff timestamps are in admission-ledger.json.
